% TeX Live 2025, doc/latex/circuitikz/circuitikzmanual.tex:2142-2171,
% Grounds gallery. Compare its two fillable symbols with the open noiseless one.
% Native: tex/generic/circuitikz/pgfcircmonopoles.tex:148-199 and
% pgfcirc.defines.tex:451-489,533-550 (class fill, node fill and body thickness).
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}
  \begin{scope}
    \ctikzset{grounds/scale=1.35,monopoles/ground/width=0.32,grounds/fill=teal,
      grounds/thickness=2.4,monopoles/ground/connectionthickness=1.8}
    \draw (1.05,2.42) -- (5.35,2.42);
    \draw (1.05,2.42) -- (1.05,1.68) node[sground,blue,line width=0.6pt] {};
    \draw (3.20,2.42) -- (3.20,1.68) node[nground,teal,line width=0.6pt] {};
    \draw (5.35,2.42) -- (5.35,1.68) node[pground,red,fill=blue!35,line width=0.6pt] {};
  \end{scope}
  \path[use as bounding box] (0,0) rectangle (6.4,2.8);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
